team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 48 turns vs floor 11 (3 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Use only organizer-provided lab equipment and stationery.
Organizer-provided calculator only; personal calculators may incur penalties.
No bags, phones, internet, or personal formula sheets in the exam hall.
Produce a lab report with data, calculations, tables, and graphs.
Physical wet-lab fidelity may be proxied in software; do not invent instrument readings not provided.
Practical Examination is a team event: each country may field two practical teams of 3 students each (from the up-to-6-student national delegation).
Each examination (MCQ / Theory / Practical) is normally 3–4 hours; practical is experimental (physics/chemistry/biology combined).
Practical scoring: 40 points (MCQ 30 + Theory 30 + Practical 40); all members of a practical team receive the same practical points.
Organizers provide calculators with simple statistical functions; using own calculators is not allowed (point deduction / ban).
Leaders/observers may not contact contestants about discussed problems until those exams finish.
Submission: experimental lab report work (data, calculations, tables/graphs) on provided practical materials; marking by Scientific Committee with moderation.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: experiment lead
duties: Decide the procedure and the order of measurements.
State the setup precisely enough for another team to repeat it.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: data recorder
duties: Record every measurement with units and stated uncertainty.
Never adjust a recorded value to fit an expectation.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: analysis / calculations
duties: Turn recorded data into the required quantities, showing the work.
Carry uncertainty through the calculation instead of dropping it.

answer_format: Submit a lab-style report: data, calculations, tables/graphs description, and conclusions.
rules_text: International Junior Science Olympiad — Practical (Team). The team of 3 runs a practical task and reports raw data, analysis, and conclusions on the official answer sheet. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: About 3–4 hours. Simulation note: the hands-on portion is represented in text, so state measurements, setup, and reasoning explicitly instead of demonstrating them.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/

proxy_limitations: Physical wet-lab equipment, specimens, and timed instrument handling cannot be faithfully simulated from PDF protocols alone.
Point deductions for personal calculators / equipment complaints are host-operational and hard to proxy.
